## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🧪 **Show a high school coach who cannot apply yet what they still have to do.** The NTHS sidebar link takes them to a preview of the application page: how many days are left to apply, what NTHS gets them, and each requirement marked done, in review, or still to do with a link to the next step. The apply button is disabled, and once they meet every requirement the link goes to the real application instead. The preview goes away when applications close on Sep 30. A coach sees it when the only things left are finishing training, finishing the safety screening, or completing a first tutoring session; coaches who are banned, already in a chapter, have applied before, or are not in high school do not. Both the preview ([`nths-apply-preview-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/894044)) and the application page ([`nths-application-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/593343)) reach every coach, with subway's eligibility service deciding who actually sees either one: the eligibility conditions came off the application-page flag on Sep 18. ([subway !2956](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2956), [high-line !1912](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1912); copy and layout in [high-line !1918](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1918)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Give NTHS members a Circle community in place of the Slack link.** An "NTHS Community" sidebar link opens Circle in a new tab, with separate invites for chapter admins and for members-only, and the Slack button stays for every other coach ([high-line !1907](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1907)); it only appears once the coach has passed safety approval ([high-line !1915](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1915)); clicking it fires `NTHS_CIRCLE_COMMUNITY_LINK_CLICKED` carrying whether the coach is an admin ([high-line !1916](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1916)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Record whether a chapter is getting help from a partnership coordinator.** A `receiving_coordinator_support` boolean on `nths_groups`, defaulting to false. Nothing reads it yet. ([subway !2962](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2962)) *Kasozi Wilson*

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- 🧪 **Ask coaches whether they want students to see when they are online.** A modal on the coach dashboard, shown once, asking whether to share online status, defaulting to yes; a coach who says no can give a reason but does not have to, and dismissing it saves whichever option was selected. Submitting and dismissing each fire their own event. Reaches everyone in the "Dogfood Eaters" cohort, plus 20% of coaches ([`volunteer-show-online-status-fake-door`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/891017)). ([high-line !1909](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1909)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Let a coach choose what a student sees about them.** The opt-in was an experiment; this makes it a feature. The fields a coach picks are stored as an array on `volunteer_profiles`, so total hours, sessions, students helped, and occupation stay read from where they already live ([subway !2938](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2938)); that array becomes the source of truth instead of passing the information over sockets ([subway !2939](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2939), [high-line !1901](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1901)); a tutor info card shown to students and previewed by coaches ([high-line !1902](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1902)); the card on the student session view, collapsed to start so opening it can be counted ([high-line !1903](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1903)); the dashboard modal redesigned and shown once, with clicking outside it storing an empty array, and coaches who saw it during the experiment seeing it again ([high-line !1904](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1904)); the card added to background info in Edit Profile, where a coach can change their answer, and the feature flag removed ([high-line !1905](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1905)); tests on both sides ([subway !2944](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2944), [high-line !1911](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1911)). *Liseidy Bueno*
- 👀 **Give students a card for each coach they have worked with.** The past-coaches page moves to a card layout, the first step toward letting a student open a coach's card to see their sessions together and start or continue a conversation separate from session DMs. The favoriting toggle matches the design rather than the existing one, and the shared coach avatar stands in until coaches have their own. ([high-line !1922](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1922)) *Liseidy Bueno*

## Session join under load

The fixes coming out of the Sept 8 investigation into the Sept 3 incident, when the database saturated and students could not get into sessions.

- 🚀 **Get the session-change and presence broadcasts out of the join path.** `sessions:join` awaited both before acknowledging, about 479 ms of a 711 ms join. They run in the background now and log their own failures, `sessions:leave` does the same, and `fetchSockets` drops its `backOff` wrapper for a flat 2000 ms timeout instead of inheriting 10 attempts against the adapter's 5000 ms default. That last part also covers deploys: departed containers are expected to answer for 10 seconds, so every join during a business-hours deploy was waiting 5 seconds and failing. ([subway !2929](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2929)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Stop telling the client to retry a join that just failed.** Anything other than a `SessionJoinError` came back as `retry: true`, which told high-line to re-emit `sessions:join` and re-run the same database query, up to 10 times. Once the connection pool filled, waiting queries kept queuing instead of failing and the retries kept adding more. The `retry` field is gone and the failure carries a `reason` instead. ([subway !2926](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2926)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Put the student's grade level back on the session, without the join that made it expensive.** A Sept 3 hotfix dropped `current_grade_name` from `getSessionUsers` along with a join that scanned the whole table, but `CurrentSessionUser` still declares `gradeLevel` as optional, so TypeScript flagged nothing and the two places that read it had been getting `undefined` for a week. A correlated subquery in the `SELECT` returns it for the two rows that matter, at 0.355 ms against the old 205 ms. ([subway !2909](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2909)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Answer presence calls immediately instead of waiting on them.** The presence emits were still being awaited where they could resolve straight away, one candidate for the hang the day before. ([subway !2952](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2952)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Take four slow queries off New Relic's list:** `getUnfilledSessions` down from 246 ms to 28 ms ([subway !2955](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2955)); an index that gives `getVolunteersInSessions` a consistent plan, 939 ms to 0.6 ms ([subway !2936](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2936)); the sequential scan of all of `user_grade_levels` removed, 186 ms to 1.1 ms for 100 user ids ([subway !2960](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2960)); a `class_id` index on `student_classes`, which was costing 830 ms and is joined on elsewhere ([subway !2963](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2963)). *sammy nave*
- 👀 **Stop hammering the session list when requests arrive together.** The session-list emit is debounced to at most once every 250 ms and at least once a second ([subway !2954](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2954)); with the debounce in place the dashboard has to alert on a valid session even when it is not the newest, since the newest may be one the coach is not certified in ([high-line !1920](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1920)). *sammy nave*

## Claude on Bedrock and Foundry

Moving every AI call onto a `ClaudeService` that runs Claude on AWS Bedrock or Microsoft Foundry and fails over between them.

- 🚀 **Fall back to Claude on Microsoft Foundry when a Bedrock call fails.** Bedrock had no fallback and went unavailable. A Microsoft Foundry account per environment carries a `claude-sonnet-5` deployment, and the service principal subway already uses for blob storage was granted access to it ([GCS !194](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/194)); subway fails over to it, everything on Sonnet ([subway !2957](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2957)). It falls over on every error for now, which is blunt on purpose, and gets more precise after the outage. *Chris*
- 🚀 **Cover the services that call Bedrock before rewriting them.** A lot depends on `AwsBedrockService` and much of it was untested. This adds that coverage, and reintroduces integration tests, which are live calls to third parties, run only by hand with `pnpm test:integration` because they are slow and expensive. ([subway !2964](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2964)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Turn on strict tool use and let the schema own the response shape.** The models do not always return the JSON we asked for, which breaks whatever is waiting on the response, from session summaries through to moderation. Bedrock and Foundry both support `strict` on tool use now, so both use it. The fallback prompts were updated to match and a bug in the schema fixed. ([subway !2965](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2965)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Stop post-session moderation failing open on a malformed tool response.** `moderateSessionTranscript` kept failing because the prompt did not say whether to follow the tool schema, the prompt schema, or both, so the model sometimes picked wrong, and the error cascaded into the next moderation step never running. The prompt was fixed, which did most of the work, and the steps moved to `allSettled` so one error does not take the rest with it. ([subway !2959](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2959)) *Chris*
- 👀 **Put every AI call behind one service with a timeout, a retry, and a fallback.** Everything, including the safety calls, went through `invokeModel`, which had neither retry nor fallback. Calls go through `ClaudeService` now, which orchestrates `AwsBedrockService` and `AnthropicFoundryService` as interchangeable Claude providers and caps each at 30 seconds rather than the 10 minutes some calls could reach. It also fixes Sonnet sometimes emitting thinking tokens into the answer, by pulling the data out of the response by content type instead of by array index. ([subway !2966](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2966)) *Chris*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Show a coach the date they passed each certification quiz.** Coaches were asking Nataly for it. It reads as "unlocked", since one quiz can unlock several subjects and `lastAttemptedAt` updates all of them. ([high-line !1908](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1908)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Let a session error carry the message the user should see.** `StartSessionError` and `SessionJoinError` became `CaughtError` instances, which already require a user-friendly client message ([subway !2923](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2923)), and `SessionErrorModal` uses that message instead of matching on the error text, so a new error condition no longer means remembering to update the client ([high-line !1893](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1893)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Track doc-editor and whiteboard activity for a truer `time_tutored`.** Sessions spent mostly or entirely in the doc editor have been coming out at zero or undercounted. Quill updates and `transmitWhiteboardActivity` events are logged to `session_editor_activity`, throttled on both sides by a five-minute Redis key, and fed into `computeAbsentStudent`, `computeAbsentVolunteer`, and `calculateTimeTutored` ([subway !2905](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2905), [high-line !1881](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1881)); the throttled write then moved out of the socket handler and into the service ([subway !2941](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2941)). *sammy nave*
- **Move moderation types out of a Postgres enum and into a lookup table:** 🚀 the `moderation_type` table, seeded with the existing `contextual` and `realtime_image`, and the unused `moderation_penalty_config` table dropped with it ([subway !2931](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2931)); 🚀 `moderation_settings` pointed at the table ([subway !2932](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2932)); ✅ the generated `ModerationSettings` query types regenerated, since the parameter is a string now ([subway !2933](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2933)); ✅ `image_upload` added as a type ([subway !2934](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2934)). Adding a moderation type stops being an enum change. *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Take account identity from the server, not the request:** an SSO signup matches an existing account on the email the provider returned, and a new Google SSO account takes its email, name, issuer, and profile id from the provider's profile ([subway !2951](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2951)); the verification service methods take the logged-in user instead of anything the client supplied ([subway !2953](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2953)). *Ben Wheeler, Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Retire the deprecated image-upload-URL route.** The old flow moderated an image, handed the client an upload URL, and let the client do the upload, so once it held the URL it could upload any picture it liked. The backend uploads straight after moderation now and nothing needs the URL. ([subway !2914](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2914)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Send the partner school's id and name to PostHog.** ([subway !2967](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2967), [high-line !1919](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1919)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Nest details in the questionable-link tool schema.** The schema was wrong, which cost nothing while Haiku 3 ignored it. Haiku 4.5 does not. The details are nested properly now, and the prompt can drop the interim instruction shouting at the model to follow the prompt schema rather than the tool-use one. ([subway !2927](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2927)) *Chris*
- 🚀 **Tell expected lock contention apart from a real Redis failure.** `ExecutionError` carries the underlying errors from a failed Redlock operation, so the log now says whether they were `ResourceLockedError`s. ([subway !2948](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2948)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🧪 **Hold an incoming session for one coach at a time.** An experiment to take some of the race-to-click out of the dashboard: a coach can turn on an "add me to queue" setting, and when a student opens a session an ordered list of coaches who are online is built from Presence and shown the session one at a time, until a maximum period passes and it goes to everyone online as normal, the way a library hold list runs down before the book returns to circulation. Two flags gate it, `session-holds-student` for whether the session is eligible and `session-holds-coach` for each coach; neither has been created in PostHog yet, so nobody has it. The hold list is calculated once when the student joins rather than kept dynamic. This is separate from the Schools team's exclusive-sessions experiment. ✅ a `filterAsync` util pulled out ahead of it ([subway !2945](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2945)); 👀 the holds themselves ([subway !2946](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2946)). *Jamie Kasulis*
- **Keep unapproved volunteers out of the session list:** 🎁 high-line waits for `approved` as well before asking for the list ([high-line !1913](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1913)); ✅ subway only lets approved volunteers into the `volunteers` socket room ([subway !2958](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2958)). *Alex Lindsay*
- **Make every table replication-ready, and keep it that way:** ✅ a test that fails if a column has no `COMMENT`, so a migration cannot add one without ([subway !2950](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2950)); 👀 primary keys added to the `upchieve` tables without one, since logical replication needs a replica identity and the alternatives are an index to remember or `REPLICA IDENTITY FULL`, which streams whole rows and makes the subscriber scan for each one ([subway !2942](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2942)); 👀 the matching test for primary keys ([subway !2943](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2943)); 👀 comments written for the columns that were missing them ([subway !2949](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2949)). *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Clean up the grand-central-station playbooks.** Fixes the dev-template mappings while keeping the hackers filenames, removes the tooling for the retired demo environment, and makes a migration failure stop the script and reach Ansible through logging. ([GCS !197](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/197)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 👀 **Separate seed updates from schema migrations:** standalone seed-update scripts and playbooks built on the existing `seed_migrations` history, registered for jumpbox deployment and logging to New Relic ([GCS !193](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/193)); standalone rollbacks that revert the latest applied seed without touching schema migrations ([GCS !195](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/195)); seed execution removed from the migration scripts for hackers, dev, staging, and production ([GCS !196](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/grand-central-station/-/merge_requests/196)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 👀 **Cover PhotoDNA with tests.** That an image is scanned and the right action taken on a match or a miss, that matches are written to the database and uploaded to the quarantine folder in Azure, and that session uploads to Azure and AWS are handled correctly. ([subway !2961](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2961)) *Liseidy Bueno*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Keep Clever roster errors from blocking teacher sign-in.** Some teachers signing in with Clever hit the "Uh oh, something went wrong" page every time. Rostering runs as part of login, so one student whose name failed our validation, like "J.Smith", failed the whole sign-in. Roster errors are logged instead, and each rostered student is created in its own transaction so a failing one is skipped. 🐛 [#725](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/725) ([subway !2937](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2937)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Ask for the current academic year's grade when a student joins a class.** `JoinClassView` had not been moved onto `GradeLevelSelect` and `getAcademicYear`, so it asked for last year's grade. `GradeLevelSelect` was also passing its model value to a `:value` prop that `FormSelect` does not have, which is why default values never displayed; it uses `:modelValue` now, so the value no longer has to be faked as a placeholder. 🐛 [#723](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/723) ([high-line !1906](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1906)) *Alex Lindsay*
- 🚀 **Make the browser back button work on session history.** The URL changed and the view did not, filters applied or not. 🐛 [#720](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/720) ([high-line !1900](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1900)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Wait for the e2e containers before starting the backend.** `e2e:create` ends in `up -d --wait`, so the backend does not start against a postgres still running its seed files. ([subway !2925](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2925)) *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Make the grade level save action read as a button.** Students were not saving their grade level: "Confirm" was green text sitting where a field label goes, so it did not read as a button. It is a blue primary button saying "Save" now, blue rather than the green primary because white on that green is 1.94:1 contrast and fails AA, against 6.44:1 for the blue. The academic year came out of the field label on this page and the profile page, since the heading above it already says it. [#727](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/727) ([high-line !1917](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1917)) *Iulia Rontu*
- 👀 **Keep the session bar on screen when iPad Safari shows the keyboard accessory bar.** On iPad Safari with a hardware keyboard, tapping the chat box or the document editor scrolled the session header, with Back to dashboard, Report, and End Session on it, off the top. When a caret sits in the bottom 100pt or so, Safari shrinks the layout viewport by 66 and scrolls the window, taking every `position: fixed` element with it. Enough bottom padding keeps the inputs above that zone, so Safari overlays the accessory bar instead. 🐛 [#719](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/719) ([high-line !1910](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1910)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Bring back the whiteboard controls in landscape.** A student who opened the whiteboard and rotated lost the toolbar and the back-to-chat button with no way back to chat. The full-screen override sat on the canvas with a high z-index and painted over the toolbar, and the toggle button was gated on `mobileMode`, so it never rendered on phones wider than that in landscape, which is most modern phones. The override moves to the whiteboard wrapper, and a width-independent `isCompactLandscape` check replaces the width-only one. ([high-line !1761](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1761)) *Iulia Rontu*
